title: Market file
description: One market, at markets/<name>.json: its name, its summary, whether it is live or beta, its icon, its number, its roles, and the fields of its listings and its reviews. Every key of a field but ask is a rule, checked against each entry; ask holds suggestions, which no entry is checked against. build/README.md says what each key holds; build/check.sh checks the rest of the rules.

name.description: The market's name, the first half of each of its labels, market/role.

summary.description: What the dealing is, in one plain line of at most 80 characters.

description.description: A few plain sentences more, if wanted.

icon.description: The name of a Phosphor icon in build/icons.json, and no other market's.

number.description: A whole number from 1 that no other market holds.

listing.description: The fields of a listing here, by name. description is one text, price a price and spots one number with no unit, when a market has them; never title or contact, which every listing may hold.

preview.description: The listing fields that matter first after title and description, which always come first, most needed first. Left out: price, then the place fields, of those the market has.

review.description: The fields a review here holds besides the ones every review holds, by name.

word.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

line.description: One line of text that is not only spaces.

role.description: The role's word, the second half of its labels.

several.description: The field takes a list of answers, each different. Left out: one answer.

roles.description: The roles the field is for: in listing, whose listings hold it; in review, whose reviews do. Left out: every role.

when.description: The field applies only when each choice field named holds one of the values listed.

values.description: For a choice: its own list, or the name of a shared list in build/lists.json.

unit.description: For a number that measures: what it measures in.

per.description: For a price: what its amount may be for. Left out: always the whole deal. Never visit, session or lesson, whose length is unknown: a price for time is per hour, for a length.

ask.description: Suggestions: how to ask for the field. No entry is checked against them, any program may ignore them, and they may change at any time, even in a live market.

label.description: Two or three words, for showing a value and for a filter. Left out: the field's name in words.

question.description: What a form asks. Left out: the label.

as.description: Words for one role, by role, over the ones above; a start merges over the field's, key by key.

long.description: For a text: several lines, not one.

labels.description: For a choice: how a value reads, by value. Left out: its list's words, or the value's.

label.description: The role's own label. Left out: the field's.

start.description: Where the input opens: a place's radiusKm, a date's way and whether it asks clock times, a number as a range. Each key left out: the field's, else the piece's own.
